flags.message: While running google_web_search restricted with site:supremecourt.gov to check whether companion ERISA split cases (Trauernicht, Cedeno, Parker, Platt) had Supreme Court dockets, Gemini's search grounding metadata included a citation link to scotusgate.com alongside supremecourt.gov links. Only factual docket dates and question-presented summaries appeared in the search tool text (zero forecast probabilities, predictions, or commentary surfaced), the external link was never opened, and it had no influence on this prediction.
